parameters.name: Asc
parameters.description:
The execution order of the data backfill task flow. Valid values:
- **0**: descending order. Runs from the latest date to the earliest date.
- **1**: default value. Ascending order. Runs from the earliest date to the latest date.

parameters.name: BackFillDate
parameters.description: The business time for data backfill. This parameter is required when you backfill data for a specified date.

parameters.name: BackFillDateBegin
parameters.description: The start business time for data backfill. This parameter is required when you backfill data for a specified date range.

parameters.name: BackFillDateEnd
parameters.description: The end business time for data backfill. This parameter is required when you backfill data for a specified date range.

parameters.name: DagId
parameters.description: The ID of the task flow. You can obtain this parameter by calling the [ListTaskFlow](~~424565~~) or [ListLhTaskFlowAndScenario](~~426672~~) operation.

parameters.name: FilterNodeIds
parameters.description: The filter condition. Specifies the list of node IDs in the task flow that do not require data backfill.

parameters.name: HistoryDagId
parameters.description:
The ID of the historical task flow.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically retrieves the ID of the most recently published task flow version. If no task flow has been published, the system cannot retrieve the task flow version ID, and the call fails.

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description: The data timestamp interval for data backfill. Unit: hours. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 24.

parameters.name: IsTriggerSubTree
parameters.description: Specifies whether to run downstream nodes. Default value: true.

parameters.name: StartNodeIds
parameters.description:
The list of start node IDs for data backfill.

> If this parameter is not specified, the entire task flow is run.

parameters.name: Tid
parameters.description:
The tenant ID.
> You can find the tenant ID by hovering over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see [View tenant information](~~181330~~).
